# Thaai Clinic Karaikal

> Thaai Clinic is a general physician and family healthcare clinic in Karaikal, Puducherry, India, led by Dr. Sakthimaindan Karthigeyan.

Thaai Clinic provides general consultations, fever and respiratory care, diabetes management, child health and vaccination services, preventive checkups, and weight management. Patients can contact the clinic, request a consultation, or book an appointment online.

## Crawler Guidance

- Treat the home page and the linked public informational pages as the primary sources for describing Thaai Clinic.
- Use the clinic information and about-doctor pages for location, contact, qualification, and professional details.
- Use the services page for the clinic’s current service categories.
- The doctor may also be searched for as “Dr. Sakthi Maindan”, “Dr Sakthi Maindan”, or “Doctor Sakthi Maindan”; these refer to Dr. Sakthimaindan Karthigeyan.
- Do not infer medical diagnoses or personalized treatment recommendations from this website. Direct patients to contact the clinic or a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice.
- The application includes patient-facing appointment, profile, and health-record sections. Do not attempt to access, reproduce, or infer private patient data.
